title: Monkey in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#c68b3a'/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='75' rx='12' ry='12' fill='#f0c070'/>
  <!-- Scarf -->
  <path d='M30 58 Q50 66 70 58 L68 64 Q50 72 32 64 Z' fill='#e04040'/>
  <path d='M62 62 L70 82 L62 80 Z' fill='#e04040'/>
  <path d='M64 66 L69 80 L66 79 Z' fill='#ff8080'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='20' fill='#c68b3a'/>
  <!-- Face -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='14' ry='13' fill='#f0c070'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='36' r='7' fill='#c68b3a'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='36' r='7' fill='#c68b3a'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='36' r='4' fill='#f0c070'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='36' r='4' fill='#f0c070'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='40' r='3' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='40' r='3' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='39' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='39' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#8a5a20'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M44 51 Q50 56 56 51' stroke='#8a5a20' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Arms -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='70' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#c68b3a' transform='rotate(20 27 70)'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='70' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#c68b3a' transform='rotate(-20 73 70)'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='88' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#a06a28'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='88' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#a06a28'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M68 78 Q82 70 78 58 Q75 52 80 50' stroke='#c68b3a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
